scope: Post-result numerical diagnosis after all six new opening season paths completed; no new outcome-untouched test or policy promotion. No future outcome/settlement files read.
shared: Exact same frozen H6state/market/forecasts/chip schedule/opening/candidate procedure/objective for each solver pair. Original retained plan is an additional feasible reference, not a policy choice after outcomes.
interpretation: Compare feasibility/objective/conditional bounds and retained-reference membership, no realised points. Complementarity or selected objective advantage alone does not prove season gains or permit a production switch. Strong unmet feasible-objective evidence may motivate one separately predeclared candidate; otherwise stop without tuning.
